description: Price history for any PackIndex code (L0-L3), one value per date: every point for up to 3 months, weekly closes for longer spans, with the change between points. Depth follows the caller's plan (observer 3mo · essential 3mo · professional 24mo · intelligence 24mo); free history ends 12 weeks ago.

code.description: PackIndex code, e.g. PP, KRLNR, OCC, GAS_TTF, CORR. Use search_indices if unsure.

months.description: Capped to the caller's plan depth.

title: Get index history
